final_candidates.decision_summary: N464 is a key contact residue in the m102.4 epitope within the receptor-binding region; alanine substitution removes a critical polar contact for antibody binding while ephrin-B2 binding may tolerate this change based on known mutagenesis studies.
Y463 is adjacent to N464 in the receptor-binding region and likely forms part of the m102.4 epitope; alanine substitution removes aromatic and polar contacts critical for antibody binding.

L500 is in the lower head region near the antibody interface; alanine substitution reduces hydrophobic contact surface for m102.4-class antibodies while being less critical for ephrin-B2 receptor binding.
